description: Split a VAT-inclusive amount into VAT and the exclusive price, or add VAT to an exclusive amount, at the South African VAT rate in force on the date (15% since 1 April 2018). One amount or a list of lines, with per-line and total figures.

date.description: Supply date YYYY-MM-DD (default today) — picks the rate from the rate history

inclusive.description: true = amount(s) include VAT (default); false = amount(s) exclude VAT

amount.description: Amount in rand for one unit

description.description: What the line is (shown back in the result)

inclusive.description: true = this line includes VAT; default is the top-level inclusive setting

name: sa_vat_calculate
title: Calculate South African VAT
